_comment: Copy to embedd.json (or point CANVAS_EMBEDD_CONFIG at it) to set the SERVER-WIDE DEFAULT embedding backends. Users can override any space from the web UI; resolution is built-in default <- this file <- per-user config. Absent = CPU-local ONNX text + CLIP images. Three parts: `providers` (connection details; onnx/ollama/clip always exist and are overridable by re-declaring the id), `spaces` (which provider+model fills each modality — the configurable surface), and `rules` (routing: which content lands in which space — structural, rarely touched, omit to keep the defaults). `match.contentType` accepts an exact string, a `type/*` prefix, or an explicit `/regex/flags`. Changing a space's model or dim moves its vectors into their own Lance table with their own ledger, so the previous model stays intact and switching back costs a restart, not a re-embed. Reclaim a superseded model with DELETE /rest/v2/admin/workspaces/:id/vector-tables/:table.
_rules_comment: Optional. Omit entirely to keep the built-in routing (notes + emails + text/* -> text, image/* -> image). Shown here only so the shape is discoverable.
